canonical_statement: The Mazur-Wiles theorem proves the cyclotomic Iwasawa main conjecture for abelian extensions of the rational numbers: the algebraic characteristic ideal attached to the relevant cyclotomic Iwasawa module agrees with the ideal generated by the corresponding p-adic L-function, subject to the source's character, parity, and exceptional-case conventions.

canonical_formal_target.planned_signature: An equality of ideals in an appropriate completed group algebra/Iwasawa algebra, after explicitly fixing the abelian extension, prime, character component, Iwasawa module, characteristic ideal, and p-adic L-function normalization.

domain_and_universes: Planned objects include a prime p, a finite abelian extension of Q (or character component), a completed group/Iwasawa algebra, and a finitely generated torsion module; exact domains and Lean universes are intentionally not asserted before source audit.
hypotheses: The exact prime restrictions, character parity, conductor conditions, and exceptional components must be transcribed from the primary source.
The algebraic and analytic objects must use one source-compatible normalization.
conclusion: Equality of the source-defined algebraic characteristic ideal and analytic p-adic-L-function ideal.
